primary_variables.matched_definition: Treatment using a compound that inhibits protein kinase activity or kinase signaling.
evidence: Combining quantitative proteomics with pharmacologic PLK1 inhibition revealed a widespread, PLK1-dependent program of protein breakdown at G2/M.
we arrested HCT116 cells in prometaphase using nocodazole in the presence of DMSO or either of two distinct small-molecule inhibitors targeting PLK1 (BI2536 and BI6727).
